# GitShop

> GitShop is the distribution layer for commerce — "GitHub for wholesale".
> A wholesaler or brand publishes a managed product catalogue (a repo).
> Sellers fork that catalogue, set their own prices, and publish branded
> storefronts. Customers buy through the seller's storefront. GitShop
> collects payment, splits it automatically, credits wallets, pays out,
> and routes the paid order to the supplier for fulfilment.

## Key facts

- Model: supplier publishes a catalogue repo → sellers fork it → sellers
  set prices → storefronts go live → GitShop runs orders, payments and
  payouts.
- Sellers never hold stock; wholesalers never manage sellers one by one.
- Customer-facing storefronts show only the seller's brand — the supply
  chain is invisible to shoppers.
- Products: repo management, forking and pricing, storefronts, wallet
  and payments, order routing.
- Features marked "Soon" on the site are proposed, not yet shipped.
- Domain: https://gitshop.co
